findings.title: Keep the registered metric-alert handler instantiable
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now inherits StatefulDetectorHandler but implements none of its abstract members: counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data. It therefore cannot be instantiated. Accessing detector.detector_handler for the registered metric_alert_fire type raises TypeError, causing process_detectors to abort rather than returning the previous empty result. Keep a concrete no-op handler until these methods are implemented, or implement the required methods before registering this stateful handler.

findings.title: Build the expected occurrence with the group key being evaluated
findings.body: TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe builds its expected occurrence using group key "val1", but calls evaluate_group_key_value with "group_key". The helper includes that key in the occurrence fingerprint, so the expected occurrence has fingerprint "<detector_id>:val1" while the handler correctly produces "<detector_id>:group_key". This is an incorrect expected result for the new occurrence-generation path; construct the expected occurrence with "group_key" so the assertion checks the occurrence belonging to the evaluated group.
